notes: Teleprompter: text colour and bookmark colour now change on the output the instant you move the picker - they were only taking effect when something else forced a redraw. Moving the reading indicator now moves the text with it, so the first line still starts exactly on the line. New: Edit on screen. Press the button above the preview and the preview becomes the editor, at prompter size and in the prompter's own font and colours, opened on the part of the script being read right now - a line wraps there exactly where it wraps on the glass, so a change made mid-show can be judged for length before it reaches the talent. Prompter to my cursor sends the read to whatever line you are editing. Esc closes it.
